messages:
zach: heads-up — ran into a nasty edge-case when using AsyncEmbeddingClient with the new BatchMerger helper and rerank=True. occasionally the assembled response is missing the `results` array or contains results that don't map to inputs (length mismatch). reproducible with mixed small/large inputs.

zach: async repro (simplified):
```py
out = await aclient.embeddings.create(
    model='embed-pro',
    input=mixed_batch,
    rerank=True,
    batcher=batch_merger,
)
print(out)
```

zach: observed outputs from logs: either `{"vectors":[...], "meta":{"rid":"r-900"}}` OR `{"vectors":[...], "results":[null,{"scores":[0.8]}], "meta":{...}}` — consumer code assumes `len(results) == len(inputs)` and crashes.

anya: thanks for the report. curious: do you trigger retries (transient errors) in your repro? that often exposes reassembly bugs.

zach: yes I flip a fault-inject flag to cause one shard to 502 during combine; that forces the client retry path.

pranav: two separate but compounding issues we should address: (1) BatchMerger currently generates per-item IDs using a truncated timestamp which can collide under concurrent runs -> reassembly collapses or shuffles entries, (2) async combiner bypasses the sync path's `normalize_rerank_response()` and just concatenates shards, so rerank metadata can be lost.

anya: also saw a typing/DX problem: AsyncEmbeddingClient typings in our stubs are permissive (`Dict[str, Any]`), so static checkers don't catch missing `results`. we should unify the public return type to `EmbeddingsResponse` for both sync and async and add runtime validation.

zach: short-term workaround I pushed to my fork: post-process `out = validate_or_fill_results(out, len(mixed_batch))` which fills missing slots with `None` and raises a clear error if rerank was requested but scores absent. ugly but unblocks tests.

pranav: proposed fixes: (A) change id generation in BatchMerger to uuid4 per item + include per-request nonce so collisions are practically impossible, (B) always run the same normalization function during combine regardless of sync/async, (C) include an idempotency token header for batch retries so server-side dedup happens, (D) tighten async stubs to return `EmbeddingsResponse` and add pydantic validation that raises `InferenceResponseError` mentioning `request_id` when required keys are missing.

anya: can you add a tiny reproduction under `examples/python/async_embed_edgecase.py` that toggles the fault-inject and asserts `results` is present and length==len(inputs)? that will make a good CI smoke test.

zach: yep, I'll add the example and a unit that runs the example against our devserver with fault injection. I'll also draft the pydantic model and a small helper `validate_response()` that the client calls before returning.

pranav: creating ticket now: https://internal/issue/RI-4599 — "python-sdk: async batcher merge parity + id generation collisions + typing" (label: bug, priority P2).

ci-bot: issue RI-4599 created by pranav: "python-sdk: async batcher merge parity + id generation collisions + typing".

anya: once you open the PR, please include: unit tests simulating 502 retry, example script, updated type stubs, pydantic model, and a clear CHANGELOG entry that documents the improved error message when rerank requested but missing results. also add a short blurb in SDK README about the exact response contract keys (`results`, `vectors`/`embeddings`, `meta.request_id`).

zach: will do. target patch in next sprint. thanks all :thumbsup:

pranav: assigned RI-4599 to zach. ping @eng-ml when PR is up for review.
